maria: Quick notes from a rapid prototyping run of a coarse->fine speculative gate for bring-up of a quantized candidate. Median latency looks good but we saw some QA-quality regressions.

kai: can you summarize the gating policy and exact commands?

maria: policy: run a very cheap coarse model (4-bit quantized tiny model) to propose tokens; accept if token entropy < 0.6 otherwise fallback to full model. Ran on llama3-13b candidate. Command used: ```rundec --model coarse-4bit --fallback llama3-13b --entropy-threshold 0.6 --run-id run_9300_coarsegate```

james: perf numbers?

maria: median token latency -22%, p95 -12%, overall tokens/sec ~+30%. Cost estimate ~ -18% per-token compute. However on NaturalQA eval we saw EM down ~3.4 points and a handful of hallucinated single-token accepts. Hypothesis: the quantized coarse model's logits distribution is biased (top mass concentrated), so entropy threshold admits incorrect low-entropy but wrong tokens.

kai: examples of failure cases?

maria: pasted two short failures we observed: \n1) Q: "Who wrote The Federalist Papers?" coarse accepted "John Adams" (wrong single-author answer)\n2) Q: "When did Company X IPO?" coarse accepted "2019" but ground truth 2015; full model would have corrected.

james: could be calibration shift from quantization. Maybe apply temperature scaling or small ensemble of two cheap models to reduce wrong low-entropy accepts. Also consider a light verifier rerank.

maria: tried a quick rerank: accept coarse candidate but verify with distil-qa (cheap) scoring top candidate; added rerank recovered ~2.8 EM points in a small sample at +3% cost and p95 latency +5%.

ops-bot: deploy canary started for run_9300_coarsegate on dedicated-pool-3 (10 reps) :rocket:

kai: experimental plan I propose: (1) replicate with 3 random seeds, (2) entropy threshold sweep 0.4 -> 0.8 (step 0.05), (3) run with temperature scaling on coarse logits (tau 0.8-1.5), (4) attempt 1-token lookahead with cheap ensemble, (5) add rerank with distil-qa. Also test adversarial QA prompts.

maria: creating three eval job IDs: 9300-a (baseline coarse gate 0.6), 9300-b (threshold sweep), 9300-c (rerank + distil). Uploading logs to s3://redwood-experiments/coarsegate/9300 and will attach a short CSV of per-example accept decisions.

james: also replicate with prefix KV caching disabled so we isolate cache-induced distribution shifts. Could be KV cache warmup causing different context dynamics.

maria: good call — will run both cache-on and cache-off. Quick note on metrics: we track median/p95 token latency, tokens/sec, per-example EM/F1 (QA), and "accept-error-rate" (fraction of accepts where coarse != full ground truth).

kai: remind the team to include sampling rng seeds and model-weights git hashes in metadata. If rerank idea works, run cost model to estimate end-to-end unit economics for Hosted API vs Dedicated deployment.

maria: adding metadata in runs; next check-in tomorrow AM with sweep plots and a handful of failure traces. :thumbsup:
